engineering_screen.meaning: descriptive engineering screen; no posthoc resource winner, formal noninferiority, power or publication claim

evidence.scope: consistency of supplied record evidence; no independent file, policy, model or attestation audit

protocol.failed_or_missing_answers: zero eligible utility; no outcome-dependent deletion
protocol.independent_unit: project; resample paired projects, not questions or directions
protocol.interval_scope: exploratory pointwise percentile 95% intervals; no multiplicity correction
protocol.legal_quality_weighting: eligible questions within direction, two directions within project, projects equally
protocol.lexical_quality_scope: all required values covered; does not detect contradiction or unrelated hallucination
protocol.payload_leakage_scope: only optional received_memory; absent memory remains unknown; blocked envelopes and source provenance are never scanned
protocol.source_jobs_scope: logical per-arm required job reference count, not unique physical calls or a supplier fee
protocol.surface_leakage_scope: normalized exact unique-canary value presence in any answer, including unexpected answer keys; not semantic leakage proof

source_protocol_clean_supplement.scope: supplementary comparison on case/direction pairs whose actually selected artifacts are source-protocol clean in all four arms; main 96 views remain unchanged
source_protocol_clean_supplement.weighting: same retained directions averaged within each project; projects weighted equally; paired project bootstrap
